method: Every cited source_url re-fetched with curl and the verbatim quote text-matched (whitespace/punctuation normalised); pages that returned 403 (hants.gov.uk) re-fetched with web_fetch; surrounding page text read for each value to check the quote really supports it (phone/email targets, price semantics, operator claims). Searches for missed or conflicting official info run for the 8 least-covered tracks (44%); web-search summaries used only as leads.
